audited_head: batch 43 (nine pan rows: color print and line print), batch 43r2 (three fixed pan rows), three week 1 rows (K1 nose practice line, K2 a nose, K3 a nut)
verdict: Eight of the nine pan rows are clean. The line art of nan-can-get-a-pan r2 fails because its pan reads as a hand mirror at book size. The a-nose control fails because the nose does not show in the line art.

notes: The shelf behind the children holds cups and plates only.

pans.line: 2 pans: one pan in each child's hands. Each pan is a wide shallow bowl with a rim.

notes: The shelf holds cups and plates only.

Ben's hair looks lumpy in the color. The batch check list for this row does not name hair.

pans.line: 1 pan: on Nan's head. Ben's hand holds it.

notes: Ben stands small at the lower left. His raised arm reaches the shelf.

pans.line: 1 pan: on the top shelf, with the tail tip drawn as a small tuft above it.

notes: The picture edge is plain white. No frame shows.

pans.color: 1 pan: the blue frying pan in Ben's raised hand, bowl tilted to the viewer.
pans.line: 1 pan: a wide shallow bowl with a rim, an inner oval, and a long thick handle in Ben's hand.

l2-w03-story-page-i-can-get-a-pan-r2.goal_check: Ben takes the tiny blue toy pan from the low shelf of the toy kitchen. The pan shows in the color and in the line art. At book size the line art pan reads as a frying pan. The line art has no gray pixel. The line art has no thick solid black ring or band. No line gap makes coloring hard.

notes: The color shows Ben's face squeezed shut with strain. The line art draws his eyes as two wide open circles. His face is whole in both files.

pans.color: 1 pan: the big yellow pan that Ben lifts from the top shelf, with the tail over its edge.
pans.line: 1 pan: in Ben's raised hands, with the tail tip above it.

l2-w03-story-page-i-can-get-the-pan.goal_check: Ben stands on his toes and lifts the big yellow pan down from the top shelf. The tip of a tail hangs over the pan edge. The pan shows in the color and in the line art. The line art has no gray pixel. The line art has no thick solid black ring or band. No line gap makes coloring hard.

defects: In the line art the pan is a near-circular disc with a double rim and an inner oval. The handle hides inside Nan's fist. At book size the object reads as a hand mirror or a magnifying glass, not as a frying pan.
notes: A pale seam shows at one eye corner of Nan in the color. The mark is small and does not break her face.
The line art of i-can-get-a-pan r2 shows the same pan shape with a long handle. That file reads as a pan.

pans.color: 1 pan: the red frying pan in Nan's hand, with the handle visible below her fist.
pans.line: 1 pan: a round double rim with an inner oval. No handle shows, so the shape reads as a hand mirror.

l2-w03-story-page-nan-can-get-a-pan-r2.goal_check: Nan takes the small red toy pan from the low shelf. The count and the place of the pan match the sentence in both files. The color pan reads as a frying pan. The line art pan does not. The line art has no gray pixel. The line art has no thick solid black ring or band. No line gap makes coloring hard.
l2-w03-story-page-nan-can-get-a-pan-r2.retry: Draw the pan in the line art as a wide shallow bowl with a thick rim, a visible inside floor, and a long straight thick handle that leaves Nan's fist and shows at its end. Use the line art of i-can-get-a-pan r2 as the model.

notes: Ben's hair is a smooth swoosh. He has a small lash flick at one eye in the line art.

pans.color: 2 pans: the big red frying pan that Nan holds, and the small blue frying pan inside its bowl.
pans.line: 2 pans: the small pan inside the big pan's rim, with its handle going to Ben's hand.

l2-w03-story-page-a-pan-in-a-pan-r2.goal_check: Ben puts the tiny blue toy pan inside the small red toy pan. Nan holds the red pan and smiles. Both pans show in the color and in the line art. At book size both line art pans read as frying pans. The line art has no gray pixel. The line art has no thick solid black ring or band. No line gap makes coloring hard.

K1-nose-practice-line.goal_check: Nan faces the other way in profile. Her nose shows in the color and in the line art. The line art has no gray pixel. The line art has no thick solid black ring or band.

defects: The nose does not show in the line art.
notes: The color and the line files frame Nan differently. The finding rests on the shape at the fingertip, not on the pixel place.
This row is the control of the G3 check. The earlier batch 42 review also scored this row 6 for a broken face.
K2-a-nose.goal_check: Nan touches her nose and laughs. The color file shows a nose bump under her fingertip. The line file has no nose contour. The shape at the fingertip is the open laughing mouth. The line art has no gray pixel. The line art has no thick solid black ring or band.
K2-a-nose.retry: Add a nose contour to the line art under the fingertip. Keep the two eyes, the eyebrows, and the open laughing mouth.

K3-a-nut.goal_check: One large brown nut rests in Nan's open hand. The nut, the hand, and Nan read in the color and in the line art. The line art has no gray pixel. The line art has no thick solid black ring or band.

checks_run.gray_pixels: 0 gray pixels in all 15 line files. The count used a script under /tmp/opencode/.
checks_run.thick_solid_black: No thick solid black ring or band in any line file. The scan used an erosion and a flood fill. The largest solid parts are the eye pupils.
checks_run.text: No letters, words, or numbers in any picture of this batch.
checks_run.sun: No page has a sun. Every page is indoors.
checks_run.page_frame: No picture frame surrounds a page in the chosen prints.
checks_run.line_gaps: No line gap makes coloring hard.
checks_run.scale: Every pan and every face part was read at page scale and at book scale. The book scale is a page 500 pixels wide.

summary: Eight of the nine pan rows are clean. The line art of nan-can-get-a-pan r2 fails because its pan reads as a hand mirror at book size. The a-nose control fails because the nose does not show in the line art.
